items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Buchanan, the manager of the Savoy, got in touch with Willie

ctx.x: And he later is to become Earl Jackson when Irving Mills takes him on. But he had a band...

He was out of the Savoy Bearcats band, which was one of the first bands...which was the first band to open the Savoy, you know. He was the drummer in the band. And I think that was Duncan Mayo's band. I think Duncan Mayo was the leader of that band. Well, that was in 1926, that the Savoy opened up -- he was the drummer in the band. And later on, hen they wanted a band in the Savoy, Buchanan, the manager of the Savoy, got in touch with Willie, and Willie got together some musicians for him, and founded Willie…
